Canadian college programs in select areas

This document shows programs at Canadian colleges and institutes in selected areas. Use the category filters and search tools below to explore programs. Click any row to view a full program and institution profile, or use the Explore Profiles tab to discover programs at random.

Category:

Programs by Category

Total number of programs in each topic category. Categories reflect the subject area groupings used to organise this dataset.

Programs by Credential

Breakdown of programs by the type of credential awarded on completion, showing the range of qualification levels available.

Programs by Province

Distribution of programs across Canadian provinces and territories. Use this to identify regional concentrations or gaps in program availability.

Programs by Subcategory

All program subcategories by count, colour-coded by their parent category. Subcategories provide finer-grained subject classification within each category.

Institution Locations

Each marker represents a unique institution in the dataset. Hover or tap a marker to see the institution name and all categories it has programs in. Map tiles require an internet connection.
